---
title: "EDA Report"
output:
  html_document:
    css: styles.css
params: 
  data_type: "[data_type]"
  rmd_path: "[rmd_path]"
  result_list: "[result_list]"
  output_dir: "[output_dir]"
---

```{r, echo = FALSE}

outputs <- character()

# Iterate through the list of splits and generate the results for each one
for (result in result_list) {

	# Create a list containing the arguments required for the results file
	args <- list(
		output_dir = params$output_dir,
		data_type = params$data_type,
		show_years = TRUE
	)

	# Knit the results file
	env <- new.env()
	env$params <- c(args, result)
	outputs <- c(outputs, knit_child(params$rmd_path, envir = env))
}

asis_output(paste(outputs, collapse = "\n\n"))

```
